# Humae | Core Use Cases

| Use case | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Original Core HR | The primary link validation core HR is based on “People or candidate data entry - rules or approval processing - self-help for staff managers - results into the report or downstream system”. It is recommended to record the length of processing, the anomaly rate, the number of manual corrections, the mobile end completion rate, statutory or institutional differences and the cost per employee. |
| Small team recruitment | The main link to validate small team recruitment is “the entry of personnel or candidate data - rules or approval processing - the self-help of staff managers - the entry of results into the report or downstream system”. It is recommended to record the length of processing, the anomaly rate, the number of manual corrections, the mobile end completion rate, statutory or institutional differences and the cost per employee. |
| OKR alignment | KR alignment is validated using the main link “People or candidate data entry - rules or approval processing - employee manager self-help - results into the report or downstream system”. It is recommended to record the length of processing, the anomaly rate, the number of manual corrections, the mobile end completion rate, statutory or institutional differences and the cost per employee. |
| Continuous feedback and early performance management | The main link for validation of continuous feedback and early performance management is “person or candidate data entry - rules or approval processing - employee manager self-help - results access to the report or downstream system”. It is recommended to record the length of processing, the anomaly rate, the number of manual corrections, the mobile end completion rate, statutory or institutional differences and the cost per employee. |
